'''John Nelson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[March 2001 Findlay tournament]] on 24 March 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|AOBS/bounty hunters]] and WYS/Close Air Support, according to Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1955">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-findlay-ohio-3-24-01d1955/ findlay-ohio-3-24-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 25 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-findlay-ohio-3-24-01d1955/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
